lee: FYI ap-south1 ephemeral cluster saw NVMe IOPS burst ~09:10 UTC causing GPU attach delays.

anya: quick numbers: iops peaked ~150k, write_amp ~2x, attach backlog spiked to 22.

mike: logs: `kvcache: grow +700MB (model=long-dialogue); janitor: start concurrency=3; nvme: iosubmit backlog`

devops-bot: ALERT IOPS_SPIKE ap-south1 - suggest set kvcache.soft_limit=1.2G and reduce janitor to 1

lee: applying soft limit to hot cohort and pausing non-critical backfills now. will monitor for 15m.

anya: 6m post-change: iops down to ~1.05x baseline, attach backlog 22 -> 3. collecting traces for follow-up.

mike: follow-ups: add per-model cache delta alert, runbook note for kvcache throttles, cost analysis if recurring (dedicated capacity).
